nodes.label: ST96 Funnel Builder Admin Prototype (admin-v1.html)
nodes.rationale: Unstyled form fields get their theme colours through a zero-specificity :where() selector so component classes can override them without !important; dark theme applies automatically via prefers-color-scheme unless data-theme=light is set explicitly.

nodes.label: demo() — demo booking funnel
nodes.rationale: A note node in the demo marks where a 'new vs returning client' check could be inserted before the greeting message.

nodes.label: AI answer block
nodes.rationale: Designed as an optional step (AI is not required in a funnel); in the demo it is capped at maxTurns and falls back to a human handoff.

nodes.label: Mobile phone layout (≤720px)
nodes.rationale: Inputs are forced to 16px so iOS does not auto-zoom on focus; navigation moves from the left rail to a bottom bar, and the block editor becomes a bottom sheet, so the canvas stays usable on phones.

nodes.label: Shell (node frame component)
nodes.rationale: Every funnel block is wrapped by Shell so validation, selection, handles and the AI ghost state are rendered in one place; AI steps are shown greyed-out (ghost) with a warning instead of an error when AI is disabled for the funnel.

nodes.label: MessageNode
nodes.rationale: Each quick reply gets its own source handle (qr-<id>) so every answer-leading branch can be wired to a different next block.

nodes.label: HandoffNode
nodes.rationale: Handoff intentionally has no outgoing handle: after it the bot stays silent until an admin returns the dialog to the funnel.

nodes.label: AiNode
nodes.rationale: AI is deliberately an optional block: typical scenarios are covered by buttons and conditions, AI is only for free-text dialogs.

nodes.label: Editor (block inspector panel)
nodes.rationale: One panel component switches body by node.type so each block type can expose its own fields while sharing the panel chrome (duplicate/delete footer).

nodes.label: advance (funnel walker)
nodes.rationale: Walks the graph step by step collecting chat items and stops whenever a node offers choices, so the preview behaves like the real Telegram dialog.

nodes.label: Builder (funnel canvas screen)
nodes.rationale: Undo history is throttled (commit(force)) so rapid typing/patching does not flood the history stack; publishing is blocked while any block still has validation problems.

nodes.label: dayInfo (slot computation)
nodes.rationale: The server is expected to compute slots in exactly the same order — rules, closed days, Google Calendar, existing bookings, daily limits — so client and server never disagree on availability.

nodes.label: ds / parseD / sod / addDays / dowOf / tm / hm (date-time helpers)
RISK (agent step risk levels)
nodes.rationale: Шаги уровня 'danger' помечены как «Только с вашим подтверждением», потому что действие нельзя отменить после запуска — агент останавливается и ждёт явного подтверждения.

nodes.label: makePlan
nodes.rationale: В рабочей версии план составляет Claude (Opus) по тексту, вложениям и базе знаний; в прототипе — подбор шагов по ключевым словам.

nodes.label: Composer (new agent task modal)
nodes.rationale: Агент сначала составляет план и ничего не выполняет, пока пользователь его не утвердит.

nodes.label: AgentPage
nodes.rationale: Демо-исполнитель: каждый шаг проходит два тика (старт → готово), в рабочей версии это очередь на сервере. Агент действует только по утверждённому плану и останавливается перед опасным шагом.
